boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations at Mill Station, grouped along Mill Run Circle in Owings Mills; each is listed in the center’s current directory.

cards.title: AMC Theatres
cards.subtitle: Mill Run Circle corridor, Mill Station
cards.notes: Check the theater’s official showtime page before heading over, then choose a screening that fits your group’s schedule.
cards.short_summary: A listed entertainment stop for a scheduled movie screening.
cards.evidence_claim: Mill Station’s current directory lists AMC Theatres as an entertainment destination.
cards.access_notes: Confirm showtimes and ticket availability with AMC before visiting.
